lead_headline: Nine days frozen: Restaurant detection apparatus extends June blackout through Thursday—pipeline unchanged at 196 leads for 216 consecutive hours

restaurant.blurb: Ninth consecutive day without new leads—Thursday marks 216 hours since last detection as June freeze solidifies into second full week. Active pipeline remains locked at 196 leads (108 openings, 88 closures).

The May paralysis now dominates June's opening week as authorities maintain radio silence on restoration timeline. The invisible backlog grows while the apparatus posts its longest recorded shutdown in modern state history. Thursday brings no movement as the regulatory machinery remains entirely dormant heading toward second full weekend of June with no signals when normal operations resume.
